reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: I have try the up, however , the credits go way faster than it’s stipulated , they say you can send as many question as you can in 2 min for 30 credits but it ain’t like that. The advisories will keep you talk and ask you question to keep you on the mensagem and will rare reply on that 2 min frame , will not answer all you questions and sometimes will ask you the same question more than once. Disappointed. And there is no where in the app that you can reach costumer service.
reviews.reply:
